chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, who said: I heard Ibn Bukayr narrating from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:

Whoever commits fornication with a close relative prohibited in marriage, such that intercourse occurs, is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes from him whatever it takes. And if she consented to him, she is to be struck with the sword in a blow that takes from her whatever it takes.
It was said: And who carries out the punishment upon them when they have no accuser? He said: That is up to the Imam when they are brought before him.

key_terms.تَابَعَتْهُ: she consented to him and followed his act willingly
key_terms.خَصْمٌ: an accuser or litigating party in a legal case
key_terms.ذَاتِ مَحْرَمٍ: a woman who is permanently forbidden in marriage due to close kinship
key_terms.ضَرْبَةً بِٱلسَّيْفِ: a strike with the sword, indicating execution
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the lawful authority responsible for adjudication and enforcement

ai.seo_question: Who carries out the punishment for zina with a mahram relative in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning zina with a mahram relative, prescribing execution by the sword upon establishment of the offense, and likewise for the woman if she was consenting. It also states that the authority to carry out this punishment belongs to the Imam when the case is referred to him, underscoring judicial authority in the enforcement of hadd punishments.
